title: There’s a Claude skill literally called “I Have ADHD” that stops Claude from burying the answer.
description:
Once installed, Claude skips the “Great question,” the unnecessary explanation and the classic “Hope this helps.”

Instead, it leads with exactly what you need to do, numbers every step, limits lists to five items and ends with one clear next action. 

So instead of giving you three paragraphs about why your code is broken, it simply tells you:

Run this command.
Open this file.
Change these lines.
Then run the test.

You install it as a Claude Code plugin and activate it by typing slash I-have-ADHD. It also works with Codex and Cursor. 

And somehow, telling Claude you have ADHD might be the easiest way to finally make it stop yapping.
